slokas.sl: मङ्गलं भवतु प्रीत्या सुखं शान्तिश्च सर्वदा । आयुरारोग्यमैश्वर्यं विद्या कीर्तिश्च वर्धताम् ॥

en.m: May auspiciousness come to you with love, and happiness and peace always; may long life, health, prosperity, learning and good name keep growing.

slokas.sl: दीपावल्याः प्रकाशेन तमो नश्यतु जीवने । लक्ष्मीर्वसतु ते गेहे ज्ञानदीपो विराजताम् ॥

en.m: By the light of Dīpāvalī may darkness vanish from your life; may Lakṣmī dwell in your home, and may the lamp of knowledge shine bright.

slokas.sl: शतायुर्भव सौख्येन शुभे ते जन्मवासरे । ईश्वरस्य कृपादृष्ट्या पूर्णाः सन्तु मनोरथाः ॥

en.m: On your auspicious birthday, may you live a hundred years in happiness; by the gracious glance of God, may all your wishes be fulfilled.

slokas.sl: नववर्षमिदं भूयात् सर्वेषां सुखदायकम् । नवोत्साहो नवाशा च जीवने ते प्रवर्धताम् ॥

en.m: May this New Year bring happiness to everyone; may new enthusiasm and new hope grow in your life.

slokas.sl: उत्तरायणसूर्यस्य किरणाः पावनाः शुभाः । दिशन्तु ते समृद्धिं च माधुर्यं च तिलैः सह ॥

en.m: May the pure and auspicious rays of the northward-turning Sun bring you prosperity, and sweetness together with sesame.

slokas.sl: दम्पत्योः प्रेमबन्धोऽयं दृढो भवतु नित्यशः । उमामहेश्वरौ यद्वत् तथा सौख्येन जीवतम् ॥

en.m: May this bond of love between husband and wife grow ever stronger; like Umā and Maheśvara, may you two live together in happiness.

slokas.sl: गुरोः कृपाप्रकाशेन नश्यत्यज्ञानसन्ततिः । पूर्णिमायां गुरुं नत्वा विद्यां प्राप्नुहि शाश्वतीम् ॥

en.m: By the light of the Guru's grace the darkness of ignorance is destroyed; bowing to the Guru on this full-moon day, may you gain lasting knowledge.

slokas.sl: गणनाथः सदा तुभ्यं ददातु सिद्धिमुत्तमाम् । चतुर्थ्यां मोदकैः प्रीतो विघ्नान् हरतु सर्वदा ॥

en.m: May Gaṇapati always grant you the highest success; pleased with modakas on Caturthī, may he remove all your obstacles forever.

slokas.sl: नवरात्रेषु या देवी नवरूपैः प्रपूजिता । सा ददातु जयं शक्तिं विजयादशमीदिने ॥

en.m: May the Goddess, worshipped in her nine forms during Navarātri, grant you victory and strength on the day of Vijayadaśamī.

slokas.sl: रक्षासूत्रमिदं बद्धं भगिन्या प्रेमपूर्वकम् । रक्षतु भ्रातरं नित्यं स्नेहबन्धश्च वर्धताम् ॥

en.m: This sacred thread is tied by a sister with love; may it protect the brother always, and may the bond of affection keep growing.

slokas.sl: होलिकायाः शुभे पर्वे जीवनं वर्णरञ्जितम् । द्वेषं दहतु होलाग्निः प्रेम्णा भवतु सङ्गमः ॥

en.m: On the auspicious festival of Holī, may life be bright with colours; may the Holī fire burn away hatred, and may all meet together in love.

slokas.sl: परीक्षासु च कार्येषु विजयस्ते भवेत्सदा । श्रमेण धैर्ययुक्तेन सिद्धिस्त्वामनुगच्छतु ॥

en.m: In examinations and in every task, may victory always be yours; through hard work joined with patience, may success follow you.
